description:
This plugin provides a tenant configuration to set provisioning for SAP S/4HANA and SAP GRC on an existing tenant.

        It supports three SAP GRC access governance models: MEMORITY_NATIVE, MEMORITY_GRC_RISK_ANALYSIS and SAP_GRC_DELEGATION.

        Use it on a tenant project that you initialized with the **Initialize project** action of MIT.

        Please refer to the [documentation](https://doc.memority.eu/setup-guide/latest/sap-provisioning-plugin) before use.
